method: Same-source configured stable-order bank/mip correctness only. Variant setup during World3DLayer.create occurs before prepare/first draw. No per-frame pose/key observation. Legacy cache-dependent ordering is preserved as historical failed evidence, not the visual oracle. One held mixed 100-unit / 20-kind scene, deterministic cast/attack/carry and blood histories. 24 zoom / real-CDP-DPR / window-size combinations, empty camera return, high-low-high mip-promotion first-frame and repeat probes. Exactly one production WorldPresentation draw per step, followed by WebGL fence completion. Native physical-resolution actor PNG (including rendered shadow alpha), full-resolution ground+actors+HUD composite PNG, untouched drawing-buffer RGBA SHA, exact PNG RGBA SHA, source hashes, retained resource counters, production picking and frozen fact/clock hashes. No presentation performance or hardware-FPS claims.
